content:
This orac module is based on the F delay effect module.
I was missing the ability to do dub-style delay "hits", so I added a toggle for the effect on the aux button.  Hit "AUX" and incoming audio is piped to the delay line.  Hit "AUX" again to disengage the effect.  The LED should light up red when the audio is running to the delay.

Knob1 - mix
Knob2 - delay time
Knob3 - feedback
Knob4 - high-pass filter cutoff
Aux - toggle on/off delay effect
